overall: 18 questions: easy 8 (44%), medium 8 (44%), hard 2 (11%) against a target of at most 25% easy and at least 25% hard, so the batch is easy-heavy and short of hard items; three sets (06, 08, 10) have two easy questions. Reasoning is mostly sound with only one real ambiguity (l-talk-10:1 stem). Distractors are usually mentions from the talk (good), with a few arbitrary ones. Same-word answers (10:2, 11:2, 08:0) and explicit because/direct-offer lines are what make items easy; vsToeic 'easier' is 2 of 18 (11%), at the edge of the 10% limit. Two graphic items use answers that need a second step (09:1 arithmetic, 10:1 swap); audio never says the answer cell in either. To fix the balance, add hard items (3-distance paraphrase with same-word distractors, quote or inference questions across speakers) rather than lifting the easy ones in place.
